rationale: The candidate reads as one mostly coherent mass in all four views, with a clear dominant block and a repeated subtractive gesture, so it avoids fragmentation and has decent repair integrity. However, the visible void is small and not yet strongly public-facing; the blue access edge is acknowledged only weakly, with no compelling entry seam or court opening tied to it. The silhouette is more a plain notched slab than a rich inhabitable section, so non-stair silhouette remains moderate rather than strong. For the neighborhood_living brief, the mass can plausibly support program in a rough sense, but it still feels closer to an abstract office-like or generic mixed-use object than a clearly legible neighborhood building with active ground threshold and public open-space logic. The reference set suggests a stronger carved court/terrace principle, especially the counterfactual 8 House precedent, which transfers well as a spatial operation rather than a typological copy.
